blocks.text: SAN FRANCISCO — The California coast was pummeled again on Sunday by huge waves that inundated beaches, flooded local streets and forced the closure of iconic piers. The National Weather Service office for the Bay Area warned that surf up to 35 feet (10.6 meters) was possible, along with dangerous rip currents and sneaker waves. “Stay out of the water, stay off rocks and jetties, and never turn your back on the ocean!” the weather service said on social media.
